meeting.
Before I end this meeting, I want to discuss the details of
our upcoming trip to our factory in Tokyo. Our flight arrives on
Monday, and we'll take the train from the airport to our hotel.
Now, you'll need to exchange your dollars for local currency.
The airport does offer currency exchange, but they charge
a pretty expensive fee. However, there's a bank near the
hotel. Anyway, ®on Tuesday, the on-site manager will be
giving us a tour of the facility. We'll be at the factory for
most of the day.
